findings.issue: The original receipt writer used os.replace, which could overwrite an existing file named by --receipt. Resolving the receipt leaf also followed existing symlinks.
findings.reproduced_before_fix: A disposable existing-work file was replaced by write_receipt.
findings.resolution: CLI preflight refuses existing files and symlinks, preserves the literal receipt path, and checks resolved input/destination relationships. A complete temporary JSON file is installed by an exclusive atomic hard link; late collisions raise instead of replacing an existing leaf.
focused_verification: existing receipt remains byte-identical and extraction does not start
receipt symlink and existing target are preserved
dangling receipt symlink is preserved without creating its target
a collision at write time raises FileExistsError and preserves existing bytes

findings.issue: git apply --numstat -z lists the destination of a cross-path patch but can omit its source. Destination-only validation therefore allowed deleting or reading a source outside repo/.
findings.reproduced_before_fix: An isolated full helper replay returned success while renaming WORK/outside.txt to WORK/repo/moved.txt; the receipt recorded outside.txt as deleted. A normal hunk with different old/new Git paths also deleted the outside source, and a copy patch read it.
findings.resolution: Both Git and unified header paths must identify the same path within repo/. Cross-path, rename/copy, quoted/whitespace-path, and binary patches are rejected conservatively. Header parsing tracks hunk counts so header-like file contents remain valid.
focused_verification: regular additions/deletions apply and their hashes/deletions are recorded
findings.applicability: This defect concerned the reusable helper; the current builder patch does not require cross-path changes.
